item.title: Warming trend into the weekend before a clipper closes in
item.description: A winter blast brought light snow to Northern Arkansas, followed by clear and cold conditions, a warm weekend, and a chilly start to the new week with highs in the 50s on Tuesday and Wednesday.

item.title: Baby born at Bass Pro's Wonders of Wildlife in Springfield
item.description: A mother gave birth at the Wonders of Wildlife aquarium in Springfield, with the help of Mercy EMS crews over the phone, and the newborn and mother were transported to a local hospital.
